title: Graph-Based Personalized Memory for LLM Agents: Representation, Evolution, Retrieval, and Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are evolving from single-session tools toward long-term personal assistants that must adapt to individual users across tasks, contexts, and interactions. This shift makes memory a core requirement for personalization, since user preferences, goals, constraints, relationships, and past experiences are accumulated gradually and often change over time. Graph-based personalized memory provides a structured way to model such user information through explicit relations, temporal context, and evidence links. Such representations can model not only what an agent remembers about a user but also how memories are connected, revised, and retrieved to support personalized decisions. However, existing work remains fragmented across personalized agents and generic graph memory frameworks, making it difficult to understand the design space as a whole. This survey develops a lifecycle-oriented view of graph-based persona

translated_title: 基于图的LLM智能体个性化记忆：表示、演化、检索与评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正从单会话工具向长期个人助手演进，这类助手需要在跨任务、跨上下文和跨交互的过程中适应个体用户。这一转变使记忆成为个性化的核心需求，因为用户的偏好、目标、约束、关系和过往经验是逐步积累的，且往往随时间发生变化。基于图的个性化记忆通过显式关系、时间上下文和证据链接，提供了一种结构化的方式来建模此类用户信息。这种表示方式不仅可以刻画智能体记住了关于用户的哪些内容，还能刻画记忆之间如何关联、修订和检索，从而支持个性化决策。然而，现有研究仍然分散在个性化智能体和通用图记忆框架之间，导致难以从整体上理解该领域的设计空间。本综述为基于图的个性化记忆提出了一个面向生命周期的视角。
tldr: 本综述提出了一个面向生命周期的框架，系统梳理了基于图的LLM智能体个性化记忆在表示、演化、检索与评估四个维度的设计空间，弥合了个性化智能体研究与通用图记忆框架之间的割裂。
en_tdlr: This survey provides a lifecycle-oriented view that systematically maps the design space of graph-based personalized memory for LLM agents across representation, evolution, retrieval, and evaluation, bridging the fragmentation between personalized agent research and generic graph memory frameworks.
